name: zsnd_stream_request_stop_if_active
description: zSndStreamRequest::StopIfActive finds a stream request in the active list, marks it finished, and returns one; missing requests return zero.
known_limits: tier S verification is tracked separately by the zsnd_stream_request_stop_if_active VC manifest.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a51f0 validates scanning g_zSndStream_ActiveList with zSndStreamRequest::MatchRequestPredicate, setting streamState to finished only when a payload is found, returning one on match, and returning zero on no match.
The native smoke installs a stream request in g_zSndStream_ActiveList, verifies the active request is marked finished, and verifies a missing request leaves streamState unchanged.
